title: China Mail 1895-10-28
summary: VICE-Consul Bourne arrived to-day from Canton on his way for Shanghai to which he. WE are indebted to the Joint Telegraph Companies for the reprot of results at Shanghai. THE D. D. R. Steamer Irene, from Hamburg, left Singapore for this Port yesterday. MR A. Wright has been elected President of the Shanghai St. Andrews' Society, Mr W. B. Buyers Vice-President. ANOTHER Hongkong Ordinance gone. Ther
